g.aria-label: Finding a Fault Across 64 Commits When the Training Test Is Noisy
Good commit passes w/ p = 0.90; bad w/ q = 0.30
Binary search over 64 = 2⁶ commits makes 6 steps
1 wrong noisy run sends search to wrong half!
Maintains posterior P(K = k | runs) over k=1..64
Updates via Bayes rule after every noisy test
Approaches Shannon channel capacity limit C!
Each stochastic training run is a noisy binary channel with capacity C ≈ 0.32 bits/run (at p=0.9, q=0.3).
Extracting log₂(64) = 6 bits of fault location at 95% confidence requires at least ~17–22 runs by physics!
